mapper.sql:
WHERE deleted = 0 AND refresh_task_id = #{successTaskId} AND entry_type = 'FILE'
AND UPPER(name) LIKE UPPER(#{likeKeyword})
AND UPPER(name) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{keyword}), '%')
mapper.select:
SELECT id, tenant_id, refresh_task_id, entry_type, name, path, parent_path, size, modified_at, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, deleted FROM srm_nas_locator_entry
ORDER BY name ASC, parent_path ASC
ORDER BY CASE WHEN UPPER(name) = UPPER(#{keyword}) THEN 1 WHEN UPPER(name) LIKE CONCAT(UPPER(#{keyword}), '%') THEN 2 WHEN UPPER(name) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{keyword}), '%') THEN 3 ELSE 4 END ASC, name ASC, parent_path ASC
ORDER BY name ASC, parent_path ASC
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
